items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I didn't know him when he played the guy, but I think he did.

ctx.x: I know another oldwood parish like that. A man's wife was in Jackson and she was writing the little son to get him. And the church sent him and got him. And when she come home, he's gone about 15, 16 years. And when she come, he died about a year. So after that. That's great. He wouldn't send him to get her.
Did Leo play slide all the time or at one time? Very good.
I didn't know him when he played the guy, but I think he did. You only heard him on the slide then? Yeah, that was at Lincoln Park then. Yeah, that was at Lincoln Park then.
